sari.title: Going to a concert
sari.weekday: There isn't enough evidence for weekday concerts (one Friday in July 2024 with an unclear pattern). The start-time option is available on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.
sari.same: If the event is as big as the large concert on {d}:
sari.f1: The park fills up to about {r}× a normal day ({p} cars that day vs {n} on a normal {g})
sari.f2: Arrivals surged from {d} before the start → from {t}
sari.f3: {d} after the start, {n} cars left in 10 minutes → {t}
sari.f4: Traffic was back to normal only {d} after the start → {t}
sari.f5: {n} cars left in the busiest 30 minutes (a normal {g} peaks at {m})
sari.transit: The park asks visitors to use public transport during large events: {s}
sari.limits: The data doesn't say which venue the event was at, and event sizes vary. Audience size is assumed to be unrelated to season, so no seasonal index is applied. The reference start time {r} comes from the most common {g} start times in the concert-poster dataset (15099006). Calendar reminders are written in Korean.

visit.title: Visiting comfortably
visit.lead: Coming at a less crowded time means less waiting for parking and less crowding. The times below are calculated from this date's forecast.
visit.quietItem: {a}–{b} · about {p}% fewer than the daytime peak ({t})
visit.avoid: Times to avoid: around the high tide at {t}
visit.large: If the text is small, switch to large text.
visit.transit: Public transport (from the park's directions page)
visit.src: Source: {s} (checked {d}). This data has no accessibility information about facilities, so none is given here.
visit.who: Who this helps: older adults who walk slowly, people with strollers or wheelchairs, and group (bus) organisers can pick times with less parking and walking congestion.
disp.title: Spreading-out calculator
disp.lead: What if some of the cars arriving in the hour before the {g} high tide ({h}), {p}, came at a less crowded time ({q}) instead?
disp.occRes: about {n} fewer · median {p}% (range {lo}–{hi}% over {d} normal days)
disp.arr: Peak 10-minute inflow before the high tide
disp.scale: Car counts are multiplied by the month {m} index {s}. Each shifted car keeps its parking duration, and the model is applied to each normal day in July 2024. If the shifted cars create a new peak, the effect gets smaller.
disp.exit: Exit queue on a concert day
disp.exitLead: On the recorded large concert day, {m} cars left in 30 minutes and the 10-minute peak was {c} cars. If everyone tried to leave right after the show:
disp.exitBase: Total waiting about {w} car-minutes (about {a} minutes per car)
disp.exitRes: Total waiting about {w} car-minutes → about {w2} car-minutes ({p}% less, range {lo}–{hi}%)
disp.exitModel: Model: the M cars of the busiest 30 minutes all try to leave right after the show, and the highest observed 10-minute exit count is taken as the exit capacity (1-minute queue). The range covers the two recorded concert days (Sat and Sun). Real waiting depends on exits, signals and pedestrians.
disp.weekdayExit: There isn't enough evidence for weekday concerts, so no exit-queue estimate is given.
week.title: This week's tides
week.caption: {a} – {b} · high tide, less crowded daytime, quiet window, busyness (4 levels vs. the week's maximum)
week.meterAria: Busyness level {l} of 4, up to about {n} cars
week.hint: Tap a date to see that day. The % for less crowded times is compared with that day's daytime (10:00–18:00) peak.
week.basis: Basis: July 2024 day-type profiles ({g}) × monthly seasonal index ({m}). Public holidays are treated as Sundays (KASI calendar data).
lp.title: Last 7 days

lp.unit: This count may include long-stay cars, so it comes out higher than the 2024 raw-data curve{r}. That's why it isn't drawn on the tide curve; it's only compared with this service's own records for the same weekday and time.
lp.ratio: (about {r}× at the same weekday and time)
lp.csvNote: This CSV is the park's live API value recorded every 15 minutes by this service. Feel free to use it (source: KSPO&CO live parking status).
why.title: Why does it fill up at this time?
why.high: About {p}% of cars arriving in the hour before the {h} high tide come for classes starting at the park's sports centre and pool.
why.peak: About {p}% (about {n} cars) of the {t} peak inflow is explained by about {seats} class seats starting at {s}.
why.highSmall: The {g} high tide at {h} comes from general visits rather than classes (classes about {p}%). {q}% of cars arriving then leave within 10 minutes.
why.contrast: Classes matter most on weekday mornings: about {p}% of the weekday {t} wave.
why.basis: Basis: July 2024 arrivals × class coefficient β {b} (±{se}) · dawn check {dp} vs actual {do} cars
